title: Metrics collector can't connect to the stats daemon's socket -- but the daemon itself is fine
description_md:
The `metricsd` stats daemon on this box is healthy -- it's up, logging normally, and listening on its local control socket at `/run/metricsd/metricsd.sock` exactly as expected. But the on-box `collector` service account (which is supposed to poll that socket every few seconds and forward the numbers upstream) has started failing every single poll with `Permission denied`, even though nothing about the daemon's own health changed. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), work out why a perfectly healthy daemon's socket is refusing a legitimate, already-provisioned client, and fix it.

You're done when the `collector` user can connect to `/run/metricsd/metricsd.sock` and read the daemon's response.
